fields.sample_size: documents and secondary data on PAC Saneamento in Bahia: R$ 89.57 billion planned nationally for sanitation 2007-2014 of which R$ 4 billion for Bahia; no respondent sample
fields.effect_estimate: PAC Saneamento in Bahia lacked a clear investment logic: structural works (water and sewerage) were prioritised over structuring actions (planning, capacity, participation) needed for sustainability; the design did not match the state's deficit profile; the neo-developmentalist logic favoured mega-projects and public-private partnerships; the programme under-incorporated municipal leadership, universalisation, integrality, appropriate technology, intersectorality and social participation/control. Documentary case study; no quantitative effect estimate.
fields.study_design: documentary case study of a national programme's investments in one state (policy documents and secondary data)
fields.section: Full text: Introduction (PAC volumes); Metodologia (documentary research and secondary data); Results (investment profile); Conclusions
fields.exact_location: Introduction (PAC volumes); Metodologia (documentary research and secondary data); Results (investment profile); Conclusions

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a documentary analysis of PAC Saneamento investments in Bahia 2007-2014 (R$ 4 billion of R$ 89.57 billion national), read in full text 2026-10-04. Structural over structuring actions, weak fit with the deficit profile, and under-incorporated participation. No effect estimates.
